# portainer_kubernetes_service_account (Data Source)

Inspects one Kubernetes service account.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_kubernetes_service_account" "deployer" {
  endpoint_id = portainer_environment.prod.id
  namespace   = "apps"
  name        = "deployer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (Number) Identifier of the Kubernetes environment to query.
- `name` (String) Name of the service account to inspect.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the service account.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on the service account.
- `automount_service_account_token` (Boolean) Whether pods using the account get its token mounted automatically.
- `creation_date` (String) When the service account was created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
- `image_pull_secrets` (List of String) Image pull secrets attached to the account.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether this is one of Kubernetes' own system service accounts.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the service account.
- `uid` (String) Kubernetes UID of the service account.

## Attributes Reference

`image_pull_secrets` lists the secrets by name; it never carries their contents.
